products.name: Sierra
products.note: Conversational AI for customer experience; enterprise agent platform

profile_text.body:
Sierra is a company that builds conversational AI tools aimed at helping businesses deliver customer experiences that the company describes as more human and personal. Its website positions the platform not primarily as an automation play but as a way to make customer interactions faster while retaining a sense of thoughtfulness, a characterization attributed on the site to Sarah Wallis.

The company's core product, also called Sierra, is categorized as an enterprise AI platform and agent orchestration system focused on customer experience. It is tracked on theworldofai.org under that category, with its website at sierra.ai.

No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are currently held for Sierra in the site's database.
